svg.title: A skydiver approaches terminal velocity
svg.desc: A 75-kilogram skydiver falls from rest. Drag grows with the square of speed until it equals the weight; the velocity graph levels off at 98 meters per second. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Drag grows with speed until it balances weight
Drag ½ρCAv² grows until it equals mg
75-kg skydiver feet first: ρ = 1.21 kg/m³, C = 0.70, A = 0.18 m². Net force and acceleration fall to
